title: Handle data ownership, lineage and access
summary: Know who owns each data source, where data comes from and who can see it. Good governance keeps data safe, legal and trusted.

beginner: List each data source, its owner and what it contains.
Mark any personal or sensitive data.
Agree who can access what, and how access is granted.
Record where data comes from and how it is changed, so people can trace it.
Agree how long data is kept and when it is deleted.
experienced: Design federated ownership with clear standards.
Align with legal and security policies.

canDelegateTo.task: Advise on sensitive data, access and retention

toolExamples.confluence: Keep a data catalogue with owners and sensitivity.
toolExamples.gcp: Use access controls and data catalogue features.
toolExamples.azure: Use role-based access and data governance tools.

leaderView.good: Every data source has an owner, known lineage and controlled access.
ask: Who owns each data source, and who can see it?
How would we answer a data subject's request?
signs: No one can say where a number came from.
Access is granted by default and never reviewed.
